parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: This is the wheel of the cart, made of wood, typically circular and attached to the base body for movement.
parts.Functional_description: The wheel allows the cart to roll smoothly and supports the load during transportation.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axle to enable forward and backward motion of the cart.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the cart, made of wood, consisting of the container and handles.
parts.Functional_description: It holds and supports the load being transported and provides handles for the user to lift and push or pull the cart.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary relative to the wheel, serving as the structural frame of the cart.
